## Highlights

- Add a dedicated PHP2Shell mode for CVE-2026-109618/CVE-2026-109619. `--mode php2shell` assesses the explicit target without crawling or running other modules.
- Combine passive PHP version evidence with bounded multipart crash-signal checks. The report's Coverage section records baseline, control, probe, and stop diagnostics, including HTTP status and request size.
- Enable per-host WAF-aware payload adaptation by default, with bounded variants, retained original payloads and matched controls. Header/protocol mutations remain separately opt-in.
- Improve request fidelity, cancellation handling and verification evidence boundaries across the engine.

## PHP2Shell safety and interpretation

Run this mode only against an isolated system you own or are explicitly authorized to test. Active requests can exhaust memory or terminate a PHP worker. A version banner or generic HTTP 500 is not proof of exploitation; an active memory-exhaustion signature is a crash signal, **not verified code execution**. Missing version evidence is inconclusive, not a clean result. See the [README PHP2Shell guide](https://github.com/akha-security/akca#php2shell-cve-2026-109618--cve-2026-109619) and the [PHP advisory](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5).

## Install with Go

The `engine/v0.3.0` module tag makes both commands install this release:

```bash
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@v0.3.0
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@latest
```

## Downloads

- `akca-windows-amd64.exe` - Windows x64
- `akca-linux-amd64` - Linux x64
- `akca-linux-arm64` - Linux ARM64
- `akca-darwin-amd64` - macOS Intel
- `akca-darwin-arm64` - macOS Apple Silicon
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` - SHA-256 verification manifest

Release binaries include GitHub build-provenance attestations and can be verified with `gh attestation verify <binary> -R akha-security/akca`.

Browser-backed checks require Chrome, Chromium, or Edge. Use AKCA only against systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akha-security/akca/compare/v0.2.9...v0.3.0
